details: Coinbase has announced the addition of Ripple USD (RLUSD) stablecoin across its retail, exchange, and Prime platforms. This move is expected to significantly boost Ripple's institutional business, with the company anticipating a $900 million annualized product revenue run rate. Rating agency Moody's has also assigned investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD.
title: Coinbase Adds Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin

details: Bitwise's research team has updated its long-term capital market assumptions, raising its Bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036. The firm forecasts a 34% annualized return for Bitcoin over the next decade, citing growing investor demand for inflation hedges and increasing adoption by major wealth platforms.
title: Bitwise Projects Bitcoin to Hit $1.6 Million by 2036

details: The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) has rolled out its tokenization service on the Canton Network. This initiative is a significant step towards integrating blockchain technology into traditional finance, with the service capable of handling an estimated $30 trillion in tokenized assets.
title: DTCC Launches Tokenization Service on Canton Network

details: New financial products are emerging in Canada, offering mortgages backed by Bitcoin. While this development expands the utility of Bitcoin, borrowers are still in the early stages of understanding the costs and implications associated with such offerings.
title: Bitcoin-Backed Mortgages Introduced in Canada

details: Ethereum developers have successfully implemented a fix for the "Glamsterdam" bug, a security vulnerability that could have potentially misdirected staking deposits to network builders. This patch enhances the integrity and security of the Ethereum staking mechanism.
title: Ethereum Fixes Critical Glamsterdam Bug

details: S&P Global Ratings has launched its Vault Risk Assessment (VRA) tool, designed to evaluate six key risks associated with blockchain-based lending vaults. This new tool aims to provide a forward-looking assessment for investors in the decentralized finance (DeFi) lending market, which reached approximately $10 billion in September 2026.
title: S&P Global Unveils New Blockchain Lending Risk Tool
